tasks.name: Fleet Coordinated Takeoff and Formation (3 Drones) 1

Then all three drones move north for 73m, and next move east for 96m. Each drone must complete the specified directional movements (north 73m, then east 96m) regardless of starting position - if obstacles block the path, drones should adjust position as needed to complete the full directed distance in each heading.
